description: Connected social accounts, with the channel id needed by every other tool. Channels the plan does not cover are included but marked available: false — so "not connected" and "not on your plan" stay distinguishable. Each channel carries its brand (a user-defined group such as "Orate" = its X and Instagram accounts) or null; pass brand to list only that brand's channels, e.g. to post to all of them.

brand.description: Brand name or id. Omit to list every channel.

name: planify_list_channels
